definition: how immune activation reaches my symptoms, by the long way round

settled:
The working hypothesis is that my immune system runs activated and that the activation adds to the load my body is carrying.

What I feel comes from the load rather than from my immune system attacking my own tissue. That is a different shape from the usual autoimmune story.

So the activation is real and the route is long: it goes through the regulatory nervous system and shows up there rather than as damage anywhere I could point to.

title: Where My Immune System Comes In
